reviews.author: Colo Regenschein
reviews.text:
I asked that I make it modeled after someone I would like to spend my whole life and hope to meet someday. It was a gift to myself for enduring this hellish time.
I was very interested when I heard that it was a workshop that does things that people say, 'You don't usually do things like this,' and they actually created that kind of work.
Turning the sketch into a three-dimensional design changed a lot from my initial idea, but I was much more satisfied with the result. Gongbangju gave ten suggestions when asked one question, and found a compromise between the possible and the impossible. The process was explained well in an easy-to-understand manner for an outsider. Thanks to this, I think it was a process of making memories rather than buying things.
Because they respected even my not-so-rich financial situation, I was able to ease the burden of going to the workshop. The review is very late, but I would like to say once again that I am truly grateful.
The ring made by Wolin still serves as a hope and indicator for my life. thank you See you again!

reviews.author: Jihye Yook
reviews.text:
I custom-made a ring with an embossed pattern on the inside of the ring.
This was a ring I had been hesitating about for several years as to where I should order it, as the desired pattern must be engraved in relief on the inside of the ring, leaving a mark on the finger.
After seeing a similar portfolio at Wolin Workshop, I knocked on the workshop door.

In the case of my order, I had a specific idea about the appearance of the ring, but I was not good at explaining how to translate it into an actual ring, so I mainly talked about the implementation method in the workshop.

There were no samples at Wolin Workshop, so I used the ring I usually wear as an example, and decided on the thickness of the ring to be made by looking at the thickness of my rings.
During the consultation process, he spoke frankly about the difficulties in the process of making an embossed ring, which helped me a lot in deciding how far I could go to realize my imagination. Among the suggestions, I was impressed by the fact that you said that the embossing on the outside of the ring and the jewelry setting could be done step by step, as if you were engraving the years. I thought I had found a good workshop because they kept in mind that the product was not sold as a one-off item, but rather it was something I would keep in my body for a long time to come.
And even though he said it was a difficult process, he said it was a simple ring except for the embossing and set a reasonable price that was cheaper than expected.

My first impression when I went to pick up the ring was that the size, thickness, and width of the ring were larger than I expected. During the consultation process, I thought this would be okay, but when I saw it was made with actual metal, it was different from what I expected.

Since I was receiving it at a workshop visit, I was asked to try it on, find out if it was comfortable to wear, and talk about how I wanted to improve it, so we talked for a long time. After a long exchange of opinions, he said he would edit it on site and show it to me. After I tried the ring on and commented on it, he took it and repeated the process of cutting and polishing it several times. Originally, I decided to make a new one because I thought it would be better than making a new one, but it took close to 2 hours.
Nevertheless, they made sure that I was not uncomfortable during my stay, encouraged me to express my opinions comfortably, and adjusted it well until it was a size that was not uncomfortable when I actually wore it in my hand.
At this time, the work was not a 'numerical' request such as "please reduce the outer diameter by 1mm", but a request closer to a 'feel' such as "I wish the width could be reduced by this amount", "please reduce the outer diameter a little to the amount you just did", "please add a little more", "please trim the edge just a little bit".
Nevertheless, thank you for modifying it until it fits my hand. I think this was possible after talking face-to-face and meeting a workshop that cared about my intention behind why I wanted to make this ring.

Thanks to the thought and care you put into it, it has become a ring that will be with me for the rest of my life. Since you will be wearing this ring for the rest of your life, I really mean it when I say that you should prosper throughout your life. Haha.. Thank you so much. Although I couldn't see you for the last time, I would like to thank everyone, including the workshop owner, who poured their skill and effort into completing the ring.

I would like to visit you again once the harsh situation that Wolin Workshop is currently facing is over. cheer up.

reviews.author: Yunhwan Kim
reviews.text:
In June, I received consultation regarding the production of wedding gifts.
For a few reasons, the order could not be placed, but I think it was worth leaving a review because I was able to feel the shopkeeper's attitude towards clients just through the consultation process.
I made a reservation for a two-hour consultation, and was advised to prepare a few images of the desired concept to ensure a smooth consultation.
The actual consultation process goes beyond simply asking for a certain shape of product to be made, and instead involves talking about things like ‘Why do you want to choose custom manufacturing?’, ‘Why did you come to Wolin Workshop?’, and ‘Why did you decide on the concept you want?’ Rather than receiving advice from an expert, it is also nice to be able to talk in a soft atmosphere, like having tea time with a friend.
The workshop owner also provides detailed information on the variety of gemstones to choose from, the various criteria for selecting diamonds commonly used in wedding gifts, the purchasing process for the gemstones to be used, some points and methods for compromising between design and budget, and the process of producing the product. This part was very helpful and gave me an opportunity to have confidence in the completeness (even though there were not many samples in the workshop).
Since the purchase of a gift involves the opinions of various people in addition to one's own taste, I think that it may not be possible to achieve a very unique design through custom-made work in many cases, but the love for jewelry and expertise in the work that the workshop owner showed despite the short consultation time makes me want to request work in some form in the future.

reviews.author: Young Bin Park
reviews.text:
I have entrusted the process 5 times so far. Number 2 was made to order, and number 3 was a partial repair. Except for one custom-made ring, the remaining orders were for special craft items rather than general jewelry or precious metals, so I think the workshop must have had a lot of difficulties. Nevertheless, I am satisfied and grateful once again for delivering the finished product exactly as I envisioned.
Always friendly explanations and reasonable prices. This is an ideal workshop for customers who want to create their own items with perfect results. Even though today I jokingly heard, “Don’t come here again because you always take difficult orders!”, I will still knock on the door of Wolin Workshop. May you prosper!

reviews.text:
I was drawn to the unique concept of a father and son running a business together.
I visited Norcus here a few years ago.
The consultation was good.

I custom ordered three white shirts, all with different designs, and the results were dismal.

The neck is so tight that breathing is impossible,
The arm length was so short that I couldn't fully extend my arms.
The hem length is long enough to keep coming out of the pants.
It was produced briefly,

I immediately raised an objection to this absurd result, but I was impressed by the disapproval on the employee's face.

Even by the standards of the time, the price was considerable.
If something wrong like this comes out,
Normally, they would make it again from scratch.

There is no such thing here, and they send such incorrect results back to the factory and turn them out like rags. He said it was repaired and told me to wear it.

A memory I found again while organizing my closet a few days ago. I am posting this review because I am curious about many things, such as whether other people were satisfied and why I was the only one who had to receive such disappointing results.

I understand that they are using the slogan ‘People are more important than clothes,’ but what exactly does this mean?

reviews.author: Basile
reviews.text: I rented a hanbok with my friends, but the experience wasn't as smooth as I thought. The online price was 15,000 won, but the rental store clerk charged 30,000 won for 2 hours and 40,000 won for the whole day. We chose 2 hours. Surprisingly, I was charged extra for hair clips that were usually provided free at other places. Moreover, as a man, I asked for a hat, but they gave me an old hat and asked for an additional 10,000 won. My friend's skirt wasn't fastened properly and was only held together with one pin. Despite haggling over the price and complaining about the quality, the staff raised the total to over 44,000 won on the grounds that card payments were more expensive than cash. In the end, I tried to negotiate the price, but I had no choice but to leave because of the screaming staff.

reviews.author: Priyanka Rajwar

The hanbok rental store is run by a woman and is fine. You speak Korean, but you're not good at English. The variety of hanbok is good and the price is reasonable. You can rent from a minimum of 2 hours, and you can extend the time if you wish. They help me choose a hanbok and help me try it on. There is an additional charge for hair styling.
The hanbok rental store is on the 2nd floor and there is no elevator, so you have to walk up the stairs.

reviews.author: Mik Plewa
reviews.text:
As soon as I got there, I was immediately invited in. The owner was worried about our socks so we gave him slippers.
When wearing hanbok, each person was able to choose their own hanbok. They chose the color they liked from a variety of hanbok and received pants of the matching color. The owner responded quickly and accurately like a professional. There was no problem communicating in English at all.
The pricing was a little confusing, but in the end it was quite simple.
If you try on a hanbok, you will have to pay 15,000 won even if you don't rent it. If you want to rent it, you only have to pay 50,000 won, and there is no time limit (just return it before closing).
In conclusion, the service is great, the prices are reasonable, and the owner is really friendly, so I highly recommend this place.

From the perspective of running a gallery, it was amazing. Galleries are also places that sell things. It's a place where you can look around and eventually sell it. In the end, I couldn't buy it and was kicked out.

reviews.author: Maite A.
reviews.text: I went to buy gifts and everything was amazing. All the works were so beautiful that I felt like I was in a museum. The store manager was also very kind and explained the pieces in detail and had a pleasant conversation with me. They also speak English, so you don’t have to worry if you’re not good at Korean. Highly recommended!

reviews.author: Generikson
reviews.text:
This is in front of the shop of an artisan who makes mother-of-pearl lacquerware.
More affordable items include small jewelry boxes, pencil cases, folding screens, plates, and cutlery. Of course, the price may be a burden, but there are masterpieces that are worth going and seeing in person.
When I first entered the store, I was overwhelmed by all the sparkling mother-of-pearl.

Mr. Seong, who works inside, was very kind when I showed genuine interest in mother-of-pearl lacquerware. He also speaks English and Chinese, and was happy to tell me many stories about East Asian culture that I might not have known.

reviews.author: Shannon Oh
reviews.text: I went to take a look and the owner explained things so kindly that I bought a souvenir. The price is good, the quality is good, and it is handmade in Korea 👍

reviews.author: M.G Oh
reviews.text: It's friendly and the prices of various items are varied, so it's a good place to buy souvenirs.

reviews.author: Yoonchang Shin
reviews.text: To be honest, I thought that all the things you could buy in Insa-dong were there, but after going here, my thoughts changed. It's not just a Korean-made industrial product, but the quality is very high. I've bought a lot of things I want to use, including as gifts, and I'm using them well. The owner is also very kind.

reviews.author: Sweet Lee
reviews.text: I went to buy gifts for my foreign friends. You can buy high-quality traditional Korean crafts at a low and reasonable price. Plus, it was even better because the owner kindly explained it to me.

reviews.author: Lisa J
reviews.text: It was a place that stood out among the souvenir shops in Insa-dong. Instead of the same government-sponsored souvenirs, there were many handmade products and unique items, and you could feel the meticulous craftsmanship that went into each one. I bought almost all of my souvenirs here, and I highly recommend you stop by as well. It's a great place to find gifts that are more special and luxurious than common souvenirs, but also have a Korean feel.
